_comment: Cache_keys of Supabase advisor findings (WARN/ERROR level only) reviewed and accepted as of 2026-08-21 — see documentation/technical/DATABASE_SCHEMA_AND_RLS.md §30 for why each category is here. scripts/check-supabase-advisors.mjs (run by .github/workflows/supabase-advisor-check.yml) compares live findings against this list and only alerts on cache_keys NOT present here, so a brand-new finding (e.g. a live-database change that reopens a fixed issue, the exact failure mode documented in §30) gets caught the next scheduled run instead of sitting undetected. Update this file (remove an entry) when a baselined item gets genuinely fixed, or (add an entry) after deliberately reviewing and accepting a new one — never add an entry just to silence the workflow without reading what it found.
_note_on_stale_entries: The 8 anon_security_definer_function_executable_public_{adjust_user_storage_usage,approve_maintenance_work_order,assign_lead_round_robin,create_deal_full (both overloads),create_user_invitation,log_audit_event,review_compliance_item} entries below are baselined despite being genuinely fixed (20260821060000_revoke_anon_execute_on_authenticated_only_rpcs.sql, confirmed via a direct information_schema.routine_privileges query the same day). Supabase's advisor scan runs on its own schedule independent of the live grant state and was still reporting these as present when the first live run of this workflow executed (2026-08-21). Remove them once a live run stops reporting them, confirming the advisor's own cache has caught up.
